export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/indo-autotech-limited), counter states "Total Shipments 1417 Records detected" / "Latest Cargo 2025-11-29"; rows actually visible in the free view: 5 shipment rows. Exact export line quoted: "2025-09-30 | INDO AUTOTECH LIMITED | LONDON GATWAY PORT | PARTS FOR LIFTING,HANDLING,LOADING OR UNLOADING MACHINERY - 128/H0977 ABI TOOLBOX | FARIDABAD, India | UNITED KINGDOM | 84313990 | BOL 8756577". Additional export rows seen: 2025-09-29 HS 84313990 BOL 2807573 ("402/L0767 WA FRONT ROOF") and 2025-09-27 HS 84313990 BOL 0980572 ("128/L5784 WA - L/H HOSE GUIDE"), both Faridabad -> United Kingdom. Buyer-side counterparties named on the same page: JCB CAB SYSTEMS LIMITED, JCB LOADALL BUSINESS UNIT, JCB BACKHOE DIVISION, JCB BACKHOE DIVISION. NOTE: declared HS 870870 (road wheels/parts) does NOT match the observed export HS 84313990 (parts of lifting/handling machinery) — actual HS on record is 84313990; the 870870 code is not evidenced in any visible shipment row.
domestic_evidence: Company website https://www.indoautotech.com/ states: "Manufacturers and suppliers of precision sheet metal components, tubular parts and assemblies used in Automobile Industry since 1974" and "strength of over 4200 employees and 850000 square feet of production facility spread across six production units in India", with customer logos/awards claimed ("recognised as best manufacturer by Maruti, JCB, Honda, Suzuki, Yamaha"). This is a self-declaration only — no GST turnover figure, no GeM/CPPP tender award, no contract document and no annual-report revenue split was retrievable (web_search tool returned connection errors on all attempts; ZaubaCorp returned HTTP 403). Domestic supply therefore recorded as declared, not confirmed.
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs records with B/L numbers and UK destination (Sep 2025, HS 84313990), so the company is not a paper trader. Declared HS 870870 is not supported by the visible records — factual HS is 84313990 (machinery parts); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected. Domestic Indian supplies (Maruti, JCB India, Honda, Suzuki, Yamaha) are asserted on the company's own site only; no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract evidence could be obtained in this session, so domestic_status = declared_only. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the sources read, not estimated. Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey claims 1417 shipments, only 5 rows visible in free view (2 of them imports from Taiwan/China, 3 exports to UK).
